baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compressed pair نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا joins the she-camel to her watering, while the divine name recurs in رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ and نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An authorized, articulated message places a living creature and her allocated access to water inside one announced divine boundary. The warning protects not only an animal as property but the life-support entitlement attached to her.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the public speech-act that makes the protected boundary audible.
Messenger and carried message make the speaker's authority inseparable from the warning he transmits.
The fixed divine name makes the two genitives a repeated seal over messenger and camel.
The literal she-camel supplies the vulnerable living bearer of the protected claim.
An irrigation share and its channel turn watering into an apportioned right rather than an incidental drink.

changed_reading.before: The messenger mentions God's she-camel and tells the people to allow her to drink.
changed_reading.after: The utterance establishes one protected life-support unit: violating either the she-camel or her allocated water-access violates the announced divine charge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive هَا in سُقْيَاهَا assigns watering to the camel, and the whole pair is placed after an address to لَهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of earnest concern, deliberate conduct, animal management, and provision shift the sentence from a negative taboo to a positive duty of stewardship. The hearers must actively make the shared setting workable for the animal.

activation_trace.role: Earnest concern makes the saying an act of committed care for what is named.
Gentleness and deliberate pace supply a non-impulsive mode for administering the warning.
Taming, training, and managing make the camel a charge requiring competent social handling.
Providing a watering source supplies the positive obligation to preserve access, not merely to refrain from harm.

changed_reading.before: Keep away from a sacred camel and do not obstruct one episode of drinking.
changed_reading.after: Accept an ongoing stewardship duty: manage conduct and shared water so the divinely assigned animal can actually receive her provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal سُقْيَاهَا can denote a standing water-share, and its coordination with the camel makes the share part of her continuing social position.
baseline_models.mechanism: Succession and following branches activate a schedule rather than a one-time event. The warning protects recurrence: the camel must arrive in her turn, and the community must let the sequence continue.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches supplies an ordered procession of users or turns.
The literal she-camel identifies the participant whose place in the sequence is at issue.
The irrigation-share branch supplies the recurring allotment that needs an order.
The non-dominant mapped branch of following one after another gives the allotment a procession-like temporal form.

changed_reading.before: Let the camel take a drink.
changed_reading.after: Preserve the camel's recurrent turn in a shared sequence; the protected object is a schedule as much as a quantity of water.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse places the messenger's saying immediately beside the concrete camel-and-water arrangement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch in which a thing's 'saying' is its indication allows the animal's visible treatment to carry the message after the messenger speaks. The community answers the speech by what it lets the camel's body do at the water.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as its saying lets material conduct become legible speech.
Messenger and message establish the verbal transmission that the material arrangement can enact.
The camel's visible body supplies the sign-bearing participant.
Actual giving of drink makes compliance or refusal publicly observable.

changed_reading.before: The message consists in the messenger's words.
changed_reading.after: The words install an embodied message: the camel's unhindered drinking, or its obstruction, visibly states the community's answer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَسُول, نَاقَة, and سُقْيَا place transmission, livestock, and incoming water in one compact construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger root's branch of milk and continuous yield activates a metabolic circuit around the camel: water enters a living animal and sustaining yield can flow outward. Protection concerns continuity of exchange, not possession of an inert object.

activation_trace.role: Milk and continuous animal yield supply the outward-flowing side of a reciprocal resource circuit.
The she-camel supplies the living converter between incoming water and possible outward yield.
Giving drink supplies the necessary inflow that keeps the living circuit open.
Earnest concern makes continuity of the circuit the object of the messenger's care.

changed_reading.before: Water is a resource consumed by the camel.
changed_reading.after: Watering sustains a reciprocal living flow; the warning opposes an extractive order that wants yield while severing the creature's required inflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extension, following, disclosure, and covering form an alternation of timed relations before the focus. They strengthen the baseline water-share into a turn nested within an ordered cycle: a rightful participant appears, receives its interval, and yields to what follows.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the apportioned water-share whose temporal form is being revised.
Succession in batches supplies a focus-local seed for recurrent turns.
Daylight's extension supplies an interval that opens and occupies time.
Following and succession make one participant's place depend on ordered relation to another.
Disclosure gives each turn a phase of public appearance rather than secret possession.
A covering that succeeds disclosure supplies closure and handoff to the cycle.

structural_cues: 91:1-4 repeatedly pair an entity with what it does to هَا, producing ordered relational clauses before سُقْيَاهَا.
The focus coordinates the camel and her watering instead of presenting water as an incidental circumstance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of extended light, following, disclosure, and covering; I infer that this alternation models turn-taking for the focus water-share. A live alternative is that the cosmic sequence supplies scale and regularity without specifying a social schedule.

changed_reading.before: The camel has a recurrent but locally negotiated turn at water.
changed_reading.after: Her turn participates in the same kind of ordered alternation displayed by the cosmic sequence; blocking it is an attempt to monopolize a cycle that works through succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building by joining parts and spreading a traversable ground recast the water allotment as habitat architecture. The camel's share is not a detachable favor: it is one relation whose removal makes the inhabited order fail its own construction.

activation_trace.role: Animal management supplies the concrete stewardship problem inside the habitat.
The irrigation share supplies the load-bearing allocation within the shared setting.
Construction by joining parts supplies the model of an order held together by relations.
Spreading and extending supplies the common ground across which the managed allocation operates.

structural_cues: The heaven/building and earth/spreading pairs move from enclosing structure to usable ground.
The focus places a mobile animal and a water arrangement inside that already ordered habitat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly and spatial extension; I infer that a just habitat depends on preserving the camel-water relation as one of its joined parts. A live alternative is that these roots describe creation generally and do not directly govern resource access.

changed_reading.before: The people owe care to a specially designated animal.
changed_reading.after: Their obligation tests whether their built and spread habitat can include a nonhuman claimant; the water-share functions as civic infrastructure, not private indulgence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The living self and the repeated act of making even bring the camel's embodied need into the surah's balance language. The same root that accompanies the self's formation later accompanies the aftermath, so the focus becomes an offered equilibrium whose rejection returns as a harsher equalization.

activation_trace.role: The literal animal anchors the reading in an embodied other rather than an abstract moral theme.
An apportioned share supplies the practical measure by which balance can include that other.
The life-bearing self supplies a category in which bodily dependence matters morally.
Equality and commensuration supply the offered ordering of competing claims.
The repeated equality branch makes the later outcome a severe return of the same ordering vocabulary.

structural_cues: سَوَّاهَا occurs with the self in 91:7 and returns as سَوَّاهَا after the community's action in 91:14.
The focus's two divine genitives place the nonhuman claimant inside, rather than outside, the charged order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a living self, commensuration, and a later repetition of the same verb; I infer an offered balance that can reverse into punitive leveling when the share is destroyed. A live alternative is that the two occurrences of س و ي have distinct local senses with no reversal between them.

changed_reading.before: The water-share is a rule imposed on a community for one sacred animal.
changed_reading.after: The rule asks whether communal balance can recognize another embodied self; refusal converts a gentle proportional measure into an indiscriminate equalization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ingestion, rupture, and protective self-placement turn the messenger's external words into a concrete form of the inward fork. Respecting the water boundary performs protection; breaking through it performs rupture. The camel makes an otherwise interior distinction materially decidable.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the external statement that can be received or resisted.
The bounded water-share supplies the concrete line across which either restraint or rupture is enacted.
Swallowing and taking something fully inside supply a material image for inward reception.
Deviation and breaching a cover supply the destructive option of crossing the announced limit.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the alternative of restraint around the vulnerable claim.

structural_cues: 91:8 coordinates two opposed possessive terms, while 91:13 coordinates the camel and her possessive water-share.
The focus addresses a plural audience, converting inward capacity into a collective public choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward taking, breach, and protection; I infer that the messenger's water rule externalizes those moral alternatives into one observable choice. A live alternative is that 91:8 remains a general anthropology and does not map one-to-one onto the camel episode.

changed_reading.before: The warning conveys an externally imposed prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The warning gives the audience a material fork: preserve a boundary and enact protection, or pierce it and enact the rupture already available within the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ploughing, growth, and hidden insertion activate an ecological and psychic reading of the water-share. Shared water can cultivate life, but a community can also bury the claim that constrains its own land use. The camel becomes a rival claimant through whom cultivation is distinguished from concealed extraction.

activation_trace.role: The irrigation share supplies the contested ecological resource linking land, growth, and animal life.
The farmer who cuts the earth supplies the productive land-use pressure around shared water.
Growth and increase supply the life-enhancing result that proper watering can serve.
Secret insertion or burial supplies the contrary move of suppressing an inconvenient claim.

structural_cues: 91:9-10 form a success/failure and cultivation/burial antithesis.
The focus names an animal together with a resource also used for cultivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies farming, growth, concealment, and an irrigation share; I infer a conflict between inclusive cultivation and monopolizing land-water use. A live alternative is that the cultivation imagery is solely moral and does not imply an economic resource conflict.

changed_reading.before: The people are asked to preserve an exceptional animal's access to water.
changed_reading.after: The request tests their model of prosperity: genuine cultivation makes room for another life, whereas apparent gain buries the limiting claim that exposes extraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attribution to falsehood removes the warning's truth-status, while the split transgression inventory supplies both crossing a limit and water rising beyond bounds. Because the focus boundary is itself a water allotment, moral transgression and hydraulic overflow become structurally homologous.

activation_trace.role: The messenger's articulated saying supplies the truth-claim that the group can reject.
A water-share and channel supply the bounded flow whose limit must hold.
Attributing a speaker or thing to falsehood supplies the discursive removal of the boundary's authority.
Exceeding a limit in disobedience supplies the social form of transgression.
Water overflowing its bound supplies the material analogue that makes violation of a water-share especially charged.

structural_cues: 91:11 names denial and transgression immediately before the actor rises and the warning is quoted.
The focus names a delimited water relation rather than water in the abstract.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falsehood-attribution, limit-crossing, and overflowing water; I infer that rejecting the utterance lets appetite exceed the channel assigned to it. A live alternative is that the water-overflow branch is only a general metaphor for excess and does not specifically reactivate سُقْيَاهَا.

changed_reading.before: Transgression explains why the people ignore a water rule.
changed_reading.after: Their transgression takes the rule's own material form: they first deny the boundary and then overflow the share, turning a managed current into unbounded appropriation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sent messenger and the roused, struggling wrongdoer become opposed vectors. The saying is an interceptive act inserted into motion: authorized dispatch seeks to slow and redirect a destructive self-launch before it reaches the camel.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the authorized vector embodied by the messenger.
Articulated speech supplies the braking intervention made within the unfolding action.
Rousing what was still supplies the antagonist's abrupt launch into action.
Struggling through hardship supplies the actor's grim persistence once mobilized.

structural_cues: 91:12 presents an inceptive movement, and 91:13 answers it with the messenger's speech.
Both ر س ل and ب ع ث carry dispatch or activation images, but their agents and ends diverge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized sending, rousing, and hard persistence; I infer two opposed trajectories and read the utterance as an attempted interception. A live alternative is that انبعث merely reports spontaneous action and does not mirror the messenger's dispatch.

changed_reading.before: The messenger states a standing prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The saying is a last directional intervention: one dispatched figure uses speech to arrest the destructive trajectory of another activated figure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence moves from repudiating the message to cutting the animal's legs. It confirms that the focus pair protects an organism together with its sustaining access: discursive denial clears the way for an attack on the bodily carrier of the water claim.

activation_trace.role: The literal she-camel supplies the body named in the protected pair.
Giving drink supplies the bodily support process coordinated with the animal.
Attributing the messenger to falsehood supplies the discursive act that deauthorizes his protection.
Cutting an animal's legs supplies the literal destruction of its mobility and bodily support.

structural_cues: 91:14 chains repudiation and hamstringing with successive فَ particles.
The focus had already coordinated the animal and the process that sustains her.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repudiation and leg-cutting, while the focus supplies camel plus watering; I infer that the pair anticipates inseparable attacks on body and support-system. A live alternative is that سُقْيَاهَا remains a separate scheduling rule not directly targeted by the hamstringing.

changed_reading.before: The warning protects two adjacent items, the camel and her watering.
changed_reading.after: It names an integrated vulnerability in advance: once the message is denied, the body that bears the claim is disabled and its access to sustaining flow is rendered impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nurturing completion, extirpation, and equalization create a severe reversal around the repeated divine relation. The focus's protected provision can be read as maintenance offered by the divine owner; after its rejection, the same ordering power no longer maintains differentiated shares but levels the order that destroyed them.

Extirpation supplies the terminal mode that replaces failed maintenance.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship legible first as ordering care rather than mere domination.
Equalization supplies the reversal from differentiated allotment to a flattened outcome.

structural_cues: The focus repeats the divine name around messenger and camel; 91:14 resumes the relation with رَبُّهُمْ.
Provision in 91:13 is followed by a chain ending in سَوَّاهَا in 91:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, nurturing order, extirpation, and equalization; I infer a reversal from maintained differentiation to terminal leveling. A live alternative is that divine nurture and destruction are juxtaposed but do not form one maintenance-failure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The divine ownership makes infringement sacrilegious and punishment follows.
changed_reading.after: Divine ownership first appears as maintenance of a vulnerable share; punishment is the catastrophic reversal in which the order that refused measured provision loses its own differentiated stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tail, anticipated harm, and aftermath turn the focus speech into a prospective causal break-point. The messenger names the vulnerable relation before the action so that the hearers can prevent the tail of consequences; the later outcome is not external to the warning but what the warning was trying to interrupt.

The end and aftermath of a thing supply the terminal state already latent in the warned-against act.

structural_cues: The focus is direct speech placed before 91:14's rapid causal chain.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trailing end, anticipation of harm, and aftermath; I infer that the warning is designed as the last preventable node in that chain. changed_reading.before: The messenger announces a prohibition whose violation will later be punished.
changed_reading.after: He exposes the causal hinge while choice remains: preserving one bounded water relation averts the long tail, whereas crossing it releases an aftermath no later deliberation can recall.

changed_reading.after: His saying also performs a figurative watering of the hearers: it makes them take in a disliked limit, and their denial is a refusal of that inward draught before they deny the camel's literal one.

changed_reading.after: A remote vessel-and-portion network asks whether access also entails measurable volume: jar, draught, share, and full bucket shadow the politics of how much each claimant receives.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the messenger-root, a she-camel, and giving drink in one sequence, allowing transmission and animal flow to overlap.

activation_trace.role: Milk and continuous livestock yield supply the outward flow enabled by care of the animal.

changed_reading.before: The camel consumes a scarce communal resource.
changed_reading.after: The camel is a living circulation point: water received can become growth and yield, so severing her access destroys reciprocity and reveals a community seeking output without sustaining input.

strongest_changes: The camel's watering changes from a one-time drink into a protected, recurrent share whose turn is strengthened by the ordered cosmic alternation.
The external warning becomes a material moral fork: preserving the bounded flow enacts protection, while denying and overflowing it enacts rupture and transgression.
The camel-and-watering pair becomes an integrated life-support unit; later repudiation and leg-cutting show an attack on both bodily carrier and sustaining access.
The speech becomes prospective rather than merely punitive: it marks the last small boundary at which the long tail of aftermath can still be interrupted.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact double divine attribution and camel-water coordination act as a hinge where cosmic succession, habitat design, another living self, moral restraint, resource allocation, and bodily violence remain simultaneously legible. Split mappings also preserve stranger support-anatomy, forced-ingestion, vessel, and reciprocal-flow readings without promoting them to lexical glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the compressed accusative pair itself encodes an explicit warning rather than relying on an elided construction remains grammatically underdetermined in the packet.
The cosmic sequence strongly supplies regular succession, but its use as a model for a literal water schedule remains an abductive transfer.
The two س و ي occurrences may form an offered-balance-to-leveling reversal, or they may carry locally distinct senses without that causal hinge.
All readings built from non-dominant mapped roots are deliberately form-distant resonances and should not be rendered as direct etymologies or replacements for the surface words.
